excerpts.author: ivanlitteri
excerpts.content:
I'd like to help making this devnet something where any client can easily join and keep up with upgrades.

As a summary (please add or correct anything) of last/this week:
- Daisugi's infra is now managed by EthPandaOps
- We want more clients to get involved
- We have some initial specs for it, but they need some review/rework to make the above point possible/easier
- The current devnet will be relaunched with some latest agreed changes with only Nethermind at the beginning

excerpts.author: ivanlitteri
excerpts.content:
It'd be good to start reviewing/reworking the specs so we can relaunch with more clients.

I can help with that, I'd need some source for understanding the new spec changes. My idea is to rebuild these specs on top of `bogota-devnet-2` specs because I think it's a good common ground for all clients to build on top of it and it is also the current latest Hegota specs for the EL (which includes all the PQ features this devnet should be based on).

So the specs will be rebased on top of the latest Bogota devnet until maybe we merge these efforts into the Bogota devnets? I'm not sure about what the long-term plan is for Daisugi, but this is just an idea of mine; and also be updated with future Daisugi planned upgrades.

excerpts.author: jhon_fp
excerpts.content:
Hey everyone! We have updated the landing page (https://daisugi.fyi) with the latest info, explorer and faucet. We also updated the frame-powered wallet we maintain to use the latest version of leanSPHINCS, and here is the verifier contract:

0x6965C62Ad830067492f1b5528AAeF376a4AC4f76 https://dora.daisugi-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/address/0x6965C62Ad830067492f1b5528AAeF376a4AC4f76

Here you can download and test the wallet: https://nicetry.xyz

Each account verifies its own leanSPHINCS signature (7,740 bytes) in the VERIFY frame of its transactions, using about 84k gas, within the 100k MAX_VERIFY_GAS of the EIP-8141 draft

If you used the previous wallet (2.1.3.9) on the old Daisugi network, please install the new version: it creates new accounts on the devnet, so previous balances do not carry over.
